comment: Lua function definitions with a table prefix, like `function Account.new()` or `function a.b.c:method()`. The builtin Lua grammar scopes every name before `.` as `entity.name.function.lua`, same as the function name itself, so `Account` would be highlighted as a definition. Names before `:` are already scoped as `entity.name.class.lua`. This rule scopes the table names as regular variables.
